q: What carbon data do buyers ask a chemical unit in Lote Parshuram for?
title: Lote chemical unit buyer carbon data
short: Most buyers want Scope 1 and 2 per tonne of product: boiler and heater fuel, grid power at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, and any process emissions. Larger buyers also ask for main raw material footprints and a reduction plan. Start with twelve months of bills and batch records.
audience: Chemical and pharma intermediate units in the Lote Parshuram estate

ul: Scope 1 and 2 per tonne of product.
Main raw materials and their sources.

p: Keep fuel and power invoices with batch logs, so each product's share can be shown.

senseible: Senseible reads bills, fuel invoices and production records into dated, fingerprinted records, so the figure you send a buyer can be traced to its documents.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
